scope: Five-epoch BWM action-adapter retry after seven-patch restoration
summary: Training stopped during model load because user-level Accelerate gpu_ids redirected the process onto a nearly full physical GPU instead of the recorded GPU.
evidence: The run recorded selected GPU 7 but the OOM named processes on physical GPU 2 and only 69.19 MiB free.
lessons: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES alone does not override an Accelerate MULTI_GPU config with explicit gpu_ids.
limitations: No optimization step or checkpoint was produced.
next_actions: Pass experiment-owned GPU selection to Accelerate and verify actual routing.
